name: Blaze Billow
description: Throws the binding net flat and wide so the weighted rim lands in a ring around the opponent.

name: Sanguine Leadedge
description: Swings the rim weights like a pendulum from the side to crack against a knee.

name: Sinkerremedy
description: Feels the cord tremble to read the direction and strength of a netted opponent's struggle.

name: Weavejaunt
description: Steps back on the pull of the cord so the thrower stays at the edge of the opponent's reach.

name: Fastening Knotwork
description: Sends qi through the mesh so it contracts steadily around a struggling opponent's torso.

name: Gustweave
description: Releases qi into the rim weights at contact so they strike like thrown stones.

name: Lot Meshgrid
description: Chains a throw and a haul and a rim strike so the netted opponent has no pause in which to cut free.

name: Subduing Haulin
description: Pours qi into the mesh at the elbows and knees so the opponent's limbs lock where the strands cross.

name: Remnant Hemcord
description: Spreads the qi field out along the net's cords and feels where the mesh meets an obstacle.

name: Weaveassault
description: Throws the net into the qi field so it fans out wider than the hand could ever spread it.

name: Transfixing Sinker
description: Draws the weighted hem back through the field and lashes it forward into the opponent's shoulder.

name: Granite Mesh
description: Anchors the cord end in the field and sidesteps around it to pull the netted opponent off line.

name: Thornmesh
description: Holds the netted opponent in place with qi threads running along the cords of the net.

name: Loopmesh Fastness
description: Spins the net around the body inside the qi field so it orbits and catches arrows and thrown knives.

name: Chime Drape
description: Tugs the cord through the field from beyond arm's reach to yank a foot out of place.

name: Billowcloak
description: Reels a netted foe along the field's lines with steady qi until they can no longer resist the pull.

name: Scything Spread
description: Throws the net so the field splits it into many falling strands that cover a wide stretch of ground.

name: Drapebarrage
description: Recalls the net through the field the instant it lands and throws it again in a smooth second cast.

name: Wary Floatrope
description: Studies the overlap of plates on a heavy fighter and marks the seams where mesh might catch.

name: Nova Enmesh
description: Hurls the net with heavy lead weights overhand so it drops hard over a helm and shoulders.

name: Silencing Drawcord
description: Drags the hem hard across a greave so the plate shifts and pinches the leg beneath.

name: Sinker Cuirass
description: Plants the heels and braces the folded net against the chest to blunt a heavy shove.

name: Hoarfrost Weave
description: Slides the mesh over armor until its fine strands find the gap at the knee or elbow and bite.

name: Granite Drawcord
description: Whips a chain-weighted net edge against a breastplate so the blow carries through the metal.

name: Compressing Loopmesh
description: Hauls a netted heavy fighter off balance by turning the weight of their own armor against them.

name: Quelling Haulin
description: Draws qi through the mesh so jointed plate locks stiff and the armored foe topples under their own weight.

name: Murk Smother
description: Casts a dark fine veil over the helm so the opponent's narrow visor shows only mesh.

name: Waning Weave
description: Counts the qi-charged strands of the net one by one to find a thin or frayed place.

name: Smother Onslaught
description: Releases the qi-woven net with no snag so it leaves the hand as a single sliding sheet.

name: Tempered Hemcord
description: Pulls a qi-hardened strand across skin like a fine wire in a short sawing cut.

name: Meshgreave
description: Drops the woven net like a veil in front of the body so thrown darts stick in the mesh.

name: Soaring Meshgrid
description: Steps in an over-and-under pattern that lets the thrower pass through a snare line untouched.

name: Ponderous Drape
description: Flicks single qi strands onto an opponent's sleeves so a tangle starts before the net lands.

name: Mightmesh
description: Pulses qi through torn cords so the mesh knits itself whole in the middle of a fight.

name: Scalding Knotwork
description: Splits the net into a spray of qi-woven strands that part before landing on separate targets.

name: Intentdrape
description: Weaves new strands across a bound opponent's joints so each limb is held apart from the others.

name: Deedweave
description: Weaves a cage of qi strands from a thrown net that shuts around any target who steps within.

name: Hour Floatrope
description: Throws and splits and recalls and tightens the net in one unbroken chain of woven motions.

name: Perceptive Floatrope
description: Holds a net in each hand and feels that the two weights answer one another evenly.

name: Scything Mesh
description: Throws both nets at once on crossing lines so the meshes overlap above the opponent's head.

name: Gust Spread
description: Steps across the court line and swings the leaded rim of one net into the opponent's flank.

name: Implacable Meshgrid
description: Crosses both net hems before the chest to catch a descending cut between them.

name: Siltbillow
description: Steps one foot along each track of the paired stance so the thrower turns without a pause.

name: Meshplating
description: Draws the two meshes together from either side so the opponent is clamped between them.

name: Granite Sinker
description: Crosses the stiffened rims with qi into one bright barrier that stops a thrust.

name: Mayhem Enmesh
description: Pulses qi down both cords in turn so a seized foot is jerked left and then right.

name: Intentweave
description: Casts one net to herd the opponent and the second to take them where they land.

name: Silt Leadedge
description: Lays the two nets overlapped on the ground with qi so they fold up around whoever steps between.

name: Mindful Loopmesh
description: Climbs to a height and reads the target's path from above the way a hawk reads the basin.

name: Blaze Enmesh
description: Hurls the net steeply downward from a high perch so it lands open on the target's back.

name: Mesh Onslaught
description: Rakes the hooked hem weights down the opponent's arm like talons dragging through feathers.

name: Silt Drawcord
description: Circles the opponent in a smooth arc around the basin floor to find the net's best angle.

name: Torrent Leadedge
description: Spreads the net wide like a wing and sweeps it across the body to beat away a lunge.

name: Gyve Haulin
description: Snaps the cord around the opponent's wrist in a hawk's tight grip and holds it fast.

name: Hemcord Assault
description: Dives from a leap with the net released at the last instant so it lands with the thrower's full weight.

name: Sinkergreave
description: Hauls the cord upward in a sharp rise so a netted opponent is lifted off their heels.

name: Suppressing Drape
description: Draws the rim cord in a steady circle with qi so the mesh closes like the rim of a basin.

name: Mesh Cloak
description: Beats the net open in a single flare of qi that blots out the thrower and turns a blow.

name: Spread Assault
description: Beats a flurry of net-strands outward in the hawk's wing-pattern to blanket the ground ahead.

name: Lot Smother
description: Links the high throw and the diving landing and the cord seizure into one swooping chain.

name: Attuned Weave
description: Reads how the opponent's weight swirls like an eddy and times the cast to its slow turn.

name: Skinning Billow
description: Throws the net along a sweeping line like a current so it curls round the opponent's side.

name: Knotwork Torment
description: Slaps the wet heavy hem across the opponent's thigh in a short flat arc.

name: Soaring Hemcord
description: Crosses broken ground in light placed steps as if on stones across a ford.

name: Thornbillow
description: Draws the netted opponent along a curving path with the mesh flowing around their legs.

name: Chime Drawcord
description: Turns the net in a small eddy on the second track so a cut slides round the mesh.

name: Toxin Leadedge
description: Weaves a hidden snare of net strands across a path that draws closed as the river draws a swimmer.

name: Quelling Lot Knotwork
description: Joins two thrown meshes at a single point over the opponent and locks the joined strands with qi.

name: Rousing Weave
description: Sights along a landmark and the wind's direction to fix the line the net must follow.

name: Glint Billow
description: Casts across open ground from the plateau's edge so the net sails far on the rising air.

name: Transfixing Loopmesh
description: Lets the wind catch the leaded hem and lashes it across the opponent's face with its added pace.

name: Smother Jaunt
description: Plants wide on bare ground against the gusts and steps from one firm hold to the next.

name: Thornhaulin
description: Draws the net in with the wind at the thrower's back so it closes with the gust's own force.

name: Equipoise Sinker
description: Turns the open net into a gust as it comes and uses its billow to push a blade wide.

name: Charter Haulin
description: Holds the bearing steady while hauling the cord so a netted opponent is dragged along the line.

name: Silt Enmesh
description: Swears a wide cast to the gale and flings the net so the wind spreads it across a charging line.

name: Floatrope Plating
description: Sweeps the net along the plateau lip to pull an opponent's footing out over the drop.

name: Restoring Meshgrid
description: Lifts the net to the wind and tastes its speed through the cords before the cast is chosen.

name: Glint Weave
description: Throws with the wind at the back so the net opens farther and drifts onto its target.

name: Blaze Drape
description: Swings the rim into a rising gust that lends it extra weight against an opponent's guard.

name: Haulinleap
description: Steps along the sworn line of the oath so the thrower never crosses their own cord.

name: Hoarfrost Meshgrid
description: Lets the wind belly the open net out in front of the thrower to slow a rush.

name: Staggering Mesh
description: Lets the wind whip the loose cord around an opponent's arm and draws it tight.

name: Sinkerbarrage
description: Rides a rising gale to lift the net high before it drops steeply across the target.

name: Ponderous Haulin
description: Binds the cord end to a sworn bearing so the netted opponent cannot drag it from true.

name: Rumblemesh
description: Pushes the mesh against an oncoming gust so it recoils and throws the opponent back.

name: Needling Spread
description: Flings the net on a gale so it spreads broad enough to catch a line of charging fighters.

name: Hour Smother
description: Chains the gale cast and the anchored haul and the counter-gust shove into a single sworn pass.

name: Verityweave
description: Wets a finger and sights past a far mark to learn where the wind will carry the net.

name: Gust Drawcord
description: Casts along the taken bearing so the net lands where the line and the wind agree.

name: Splitting Knotwork
description: Swings the hem across the body on the bearing line to crack against an opponent's guard hand.

name: Gustmesh
description: Pivots without losing the sighted bearing so the net is still aimed when the feet settle.

name: Ironsinker
description: Pays out slack cord and folds the net into a thick windbreak before the chest.

name: Gyve Hemcord
description: Cinches the net along the bearing line so the opponent is pulled the way the thrower faces.

name: Weavecuirass
description: Sweeps the net across a crosswind so its drag turns a thrown spear aside.

name: Crippling Floatrope
description: Draws the cord taut along the oath line at ankle height so a rushing foot catches.

name: Deadfall Leadedge
description: Sets a net on its bearing with qi so it springs shut on whoever crosses the marked line.

name: Alternating Spread
description: Takes a fresh bearing between every cast and haul so each blow of the chain lands true.
